title: And Then There Were None
synopsis: Soldier Island. Ten guests. Each has, by the host's letter, an unconfessed crime. One by one a nursery rhyme is being acted out.

nodes.text: The case is, in time, closed. The book is, in time, opened by readers in every country. The rhyme outlives every culprit.
Soldier Island becomes a small ruin. Boats pass. Tourists come, sometimes, with a camera and a copy of the book.
Maine, who finds the bottle, becomes mildly famous. He retires with a small pension. He tells the story exactly twice in his life, both at funerals.
